jobs.name: CrossbowGuardIdleV2
jobs.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / identity-preserve.
Input 1 is the EDIT TARGET, a complete static masked enemy pixel sprite.
Input 2 is the exact COMMON MASK DESIGN REFERENCE, the sword patrol from the same faction.
The user wants one standardized mask model shared by all human enemy classes; rank will later be indicated by color and painted insignia, NOT different mask shapes. These current sprites are all COMMON RANK and must wear the same plain warm copper mask.

Change ONLY the face mask and the immediate edge of its hood opening in input 1. Replace the mask with the SAME geometric faceplate worn by the patrol in input 2: elongated faceted copper faceplate covering brow through jaw, identical dark narrow angular eye cutouts, a raised central nose ridge, angular cheek planes and the same tapered chin/jaw outline. Match the reference mask's size relative to the full body as closely as possible, approximately 12% of the full figure height; do not leave a tiny mask deep inside a giant hood. Warm burnished copper hue, same highlights and shading ramp, NO silver/gold class-specific variant, NO extra ornament, NO class-specific cheek shape. It must read as the very same manufactured mask at the target's existing RIGHT-facing three-quarter head angle. Adjust only tiny local hood/scarf pixels necessary for a snug natural fit. Do not enlarge the entire head or shrink the body.

Preserve ALL other target content: full-body height and exact silhouette, existing planted standing idle, hood outside silhouette, outfit and weapon, arms/hands/legs/boots and their proportions, lighting, coherent pixel grid and hard edges. No new characters, no text, no background, no drop shadow or checkerboard. Preserve genuine transparent alpha. One full-body sprite only.
Target-specific invariant: the compact wooden crossbow, bow string, hands, bolt quiver and shoulder armor must remain exactly as they are.
